function.name: Bash
function.description: Execute CLI command: adb shell (device), sql (database), http (backend), read-file, write-file, find-files

steps.message: Analyze the 'customer-feedback' channel. Identify all NEGATIVE feedback items (complaints, bugs, issues).
Find customer-feedback channel and read messages

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT id FROM channels WHERE name='customer-feedback'"
http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT message FROM posts WHERE channelid='fb_ch_id' AND deleteat=0 ORDER BY createat"

results.content: (mix of positive and negative feedback messages)
